record.paper_title: A Collection of Problems on Spectrally Bounded Operators
record.original_question: Let A be a Banach algebra and let δ: A → A be a derivation. Suppose that for every x in A the commutator [x, δx] = xδx − δx x belongs to Z(A), where Z(A) denotes the centre modulo the radical, i.e. the preimage in A of the centre of A/rad(A). Must it follow that δ(A) is contained in rad(A)? Equivalently, under the same hypothesis, must δ be spectrally bounded?

evidence.quote: Problem 1 (Noncommutative Singer–Wermer Conjecture). Does [x, δx] ∈ Z(A) for all x ∈ A imply that δA ⊆ rad(A)?
Problem 1′. Does [x, δx] ∈ Z(A) for all x ∈ A imply that δ is spectrally bounded?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be a Banach algebra over $\mathbb{C}$, and let $\mathrm{rad}(A)$ denote its Jacobson radical. Define the centre modulo the radical as
$$Z(A) := \{x \in A : x + \mathrm{rad}(A) \in Z(A/\mathrm{rad}(A))\},$$
i.e. the preimage in $A$ of the centre of the quotient algebra $A/\mathrm{rad}(A)$. Let $\delta : A \to A$ be a (not necessarily continuous) derivation, meaning a linear map satisfying $\delta(xy) = \delta(x)y + x\delta(y)$ for all $x,y \in A$. Suppose that for every $x \in A$ the commutator
$$[x, \delta x] = x\,\delta x - \delta x \cdot x$$
lies in $Z(A)$.

(a) Must it follow that $\delta(A) \subseteq \mathrm{rad}(A)$?

(b) Equivalently, must $\delta$ be spectrally bounded, i.e., must there exist a constant $M \geq 0$ such that $r(\delta x) \leq M\, r(x)$ for all $x \in A$, where $r(\cdot)$ denotes the spectral radius?
artifact.status_search_result: The noncommutative Singer–Wermer conjecture remains a well-known open problem in Banach algebra theory. Multiple recent works (including a 2024 Springer chapter on generalized skew derivations and articles in Studia Mathematica and J. London Math. Soc.) study partial cases and reformulations, indicating the general question is still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The Noncommutative Singer-Wermer Conjecture and Generalized Skew Derivations
status_evidence.snippet: Considers when a generalized skew derivation on a Banach algebra has quasinilpotent values and how this is related to the noncommutative Singer-Wermer conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture continues to motivate ongoing research, indicating it is still open.

status_evidence.title: The canonical test case for the non-commutative Singer–Wermer conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Studies a canonical test case for the non-commutative Singer–Wermer conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Phrasing as a 'test case' indicates the full conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: The Noncommutative Singer–Wermer Conjecture and φ-derivations
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates the noncommutative Singer–Wermer conjecture for φ-derivations.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on partial cases supports the conclusion that the conjecture is still open.
